snippet.title: Red Kiss - Official Fritz Character Reveal Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Vampire spy house leader Daddy introduces you to the recently resurrected Fritz and the team you'll lead in this latest trailer for Red Kiss, an upcoming tactical narrative RPG from developer Wispfire. In Red Kiss, dispatch a team of vampire spies through the tense and fractured streets of Cold War Berlin. Fulfill your darkest impulses as you tap into their powers, gain their trust, and manipulate your way through this (blood)thirsty tactical narrative RPG. 

Red Kiss will be available on PC, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Play Anywhere, and Day 1 on Xbox Game Pass when it launches in 2027.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
